title: Patient-Zero: Scaling Synthetic Patient Agents to Real-World Distributions without Real Patient Data
abstract: arXiv:2509.11078v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synthetic data generation with Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising solution in the medical domain to mitigate data scarcity and privacy constraints. However, existing approaches remain constrained by their derivative nature, relying on real-world records, which pose privacy risks and distribution biases. Furthermore, current patient agents face the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma, struggling to maintain clinical consistency during dynamic inquiries. translated_title: Patient-Zero：无需真实患者数据即可将合成患者智能体扩展至真实世界分布
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）进行合成数据生成已成为医学领域缓解数据稀缺与隐私限制的一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有方法仍受制于其衍生性质，依赖真实世界的记录，这带来了隐私风险和分布偏差。此外，当前的患者智能体面临“稳定性-可塑性困境”，在动态问询过程中难以保持临床一致性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Patient-Zero，一个无需真实医疗记录即可从头开始（ab initio）进行患者模拟的新型框架。我们的医学对齐分层合成框架通过分层属性排列，从医学知识中生成全面且多样化的患者记录。为支持严格的临床交互，我们设计了双轨认知记忆系统，使智能体能够在动态更新记忆的同时保持逻辑一致性。
tldr: 该论文提出Patient-Zero框架，无需任何真实患者数据，通过医学对齐分层合成从医学知识生成多样化患者记录，并借助双轨认知记忆系统在动态临床交互中保持逻辑一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Patient-Zero, a framework that simulates patients ab initio without real medical records by generating diverse patient records from medical knowledge through medically-aligned hierarchical synthesis, along with a dual-track cognitive memory system that maintains logical consistency during dynamic clinical interactions.
